description: This Java class, PersistableProductReviewPopulator, is responsible for converting a PersistableProductReview object into a ProductReview object within an e-commerce application. It validates and fetches related entities like Customer, Product, and Language, then populates a ProductReview with this data along with review details, descriptions, and metadata.

classes.name: PersistableProductReviewPopulator
classes.description: A class that converts PersistableProductReview objects into ProductReview objects, populating necessary fields and associated descriptions, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Transforms a PersistableProductReview source object into a ProductReview target object, validating related entities, setting review details, descriptions, and ensuring the associated language and store match.

methods.name: createTarget
methods.description: Overridden method intended to create a new ProductReview instance, but currently returns null.
